name: Street - Default (seed v1)
description: A named street. Structures and gates use it in their address, and road stretches carry its name for /navigate. Often created from a structure's or gate's Address step, or from the Roads page.

steps.description: Name the street and say which districts it runs through.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in addresses (with the house number) and as the road name in /navigate directions.

fields.label: Districts
fields.description: The districts the street runs through; a street may cross several. Optional, and can be filled in later.

steps.description: The road stretches in the world that carry this street's name. Only shown for a saved street; stretches are labelled on the Roads page or in game, not here.

fields.label: Road
fields.description: Read-only: how many stretches carry this street's name, their total length and junctions, with links to the Roads page.
